speaker: (the carter)
text: Bishopsgate is straight on, master, if you want the straight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I don't. The long way. The same as I came.

speaker: (the carter)
text: It's a mile out of the way, and the horse has already got opinions.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A mile out of the way is the point. Let her spend her opinions on the long road.

speaker: (the carter)
text: Please yourself. The straight road will keep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Later is not today. Water, and no directions.
